subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should follow-up preserve the current gateway.nodes.allowCommands and node-approval gates while investigating Android advertising/A2UI readiness, or intentionally change the camera/location command exposure contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and the source shows both command implementations and security gates, so automation should not decide whether to broaden exposure from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run Android current-main proof, keep camera.snap and camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only reproduced advertising, approval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

options.title: Change exposure policy
options.body: Broaden Android camera or location command exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split after repro
options.body: If live proof shows independent camera, location, and A2UI causes, split the work into separate owner-reviewed issues or PRs.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run Android current-main proof, keep camera.snap and camera.clip behind explicit gateway.nodes.allowCommands, and fix only reproduced advertising, approval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README names obviyus for Android app ownership, and the decision spans Android UX plus sensitive command exposure.
